item.title: Cursor capitalizes on GitHub frustration, launches rival hosting platform
item.description: Cursor, known for its AI Code Editor, is launching a new code-hosting platform to rival developers' long preferred favorite, GitHub.

item.title: OpenAI institutes new safeguards after Hugging Face breach
item.description: The new safeguards include more detailed monitoring of models during the development process, as well as greater emphasis on alignment and security during the post-training process.

item.title: Etched’s valuation doubles to $21B in a month
item.description: Jane Street has installed Etched's first shipped AI cluster system, and was so impressed, it led another massive round, the startup says.

item.title: Why Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods may not be the ‘pervert pods’ consumers fear
item.description: Apple’s leaked camera-equipped AirPods might avoid the privacy pitfalls of other AI wearables by preventing users from recording photos and videos.

item.title: Warp’s new system is an out-of-the-box software factory for AI development
item.description: On Tuesday, Warp introduced Warp Factories, a new infrastructure system designed to make building AI software factories as easy as possible.

item.title: OpenAI launches a safer ChatGPT for teens — years after teens started using it
item.description: ChatGPT for Teens adds age-appropriate safety measures, parental controls, and learning tools designed to steer teens away from harmful content — and from using AI to cheat on their homework.

item.title: Perplexity’s free AI offer left it with millions more users in India
item.description: Perplexity's India revenue rose about 60% after the Airtel offer ended for new users, even as downloads declined.

item.title: Anthropic’s annualized revenue surges to $65B
item.description: The model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in two months.

item.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google’s Chrome team
item.description: "We have some really ambitious plans to help you work with AI in Chrome to get things done, and I’ll have more to share soon," Jacob Bank, Relay founder and CEO, said.

item.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
item.description: Rare books are incredibly valuable for training LLMs, since these models have already trained on whatever's available online.

item.title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud
item.description: Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as the former AI chipmaker pivots to a neocloud business and expands its Nvidia-powered data center footprint.

item.title: Nvidia investing $1.5B in SoftBank data center developer behind OpenAI project
item.description: Nvidia's investment in SoftBank's data center developer will guarantee its chips power an OpenAI data center.

item.title: Wispr raises $280M at $2B valuation as it looks beyond dictation
item.description: The funds will allow Wispr to increase its footprint as it ventures into new areas, such as meetings, with its newly released note-taker tool.

item.title: Stripe will reportedly acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+
item.description: OpenRouter's CEO recently described the startup as Stripe for AI.

item.title: Why people aren’t buying Mark Zuckerberg’s AI future
item.description: On the latest episode of Equity podcast, we discuss why not everyone is buying Zuckerberg’s vision.

item.title: Anthropic CEO says AI backlash is ‘fundamentally a crisis of trust’
item.description: Dario Amodei is pushing back against the idea that he's been painting an overly pessimistic picture of AI.

item.title: Woman claims her stepfather used Grok to transform childhood photo into explicit imagery
item.description: The woman claimed that AI tools are "taking everyday life and turning it into child sexual abuse."

item.description: How will the watermarking actually work? Can it be hidden with editing? And how does this affect code?

item.title: SpaceX officially closes its Cursor acquisition
item.description: AI coding startup Cursor is now officially a part of SpaceX.
